reviews.name: Jobtoday
reviews.note: Business model and English language verified from the hire page. The contacts page gives only a US office address for JobToday USA Inc. and the footer names JobToday S.A.; neither states the headquarters country, so hq_country was not recorded. Language menu on the hire page shows flags only; Spanish locales were seen as links but no quotable text was found, so languages_supported lists en only.

reviews.name: AlmaLaurea
reviews.note: Founding year from the English homepage via the fetch tool. The headless reader returned a bot-check block (Azure WAF) on the same page, so the quotes could not be checked against raw reader text; they come from the fetch output. primary_language it is inferred from the Italian default site with /en as the English version.

reviews.name: Robert Half
reviews.note: Press room and leadership pages read; neither states headquarters location or founding year. Locations page was linked but not read (fetch budget used on the try pages).

reviews.name: National Career Service
reviews.note: Employer login and jobseeker list pages read. Placement organisation registration is described, but no partner programme or empanelment arrangement for employers is stated, so partner_program is left unknown. A fraud warning on the page mentions unverified claims of NCS association, which was not treated as a partner programme.
